correctness.rationale: The two displayed syzygies identify the blow-up incidence P1-bundle over the minor plane; restricting to a smooth conic makes a finite birational normalization of the quartic. The Serre-dual 8x8 evaluation matrix has determinant -1 on the exhibited conic, forcing balanced splitting Q=O(2)². The conductor E is the (2,2) incidence curve, smooth genus one; duality gives conductor divisor class (2,2), hence reduced with coefficient one. In char2, the quadratic middle coefficient B(u,v)=uv for that conic has two distinct simple zeros; Riemann–Hurwitz gives total different degree four, so each wild e=2 branch contributes exactly two. The F2 split-normalization correction #S=#Y-#E+#C and #E(F2)=4 imply Frobenius trace -1 and a_n=-a_(n-1)-2a_(n-2), hence the stated zeta function. Independent sympy reconstruction found balanced splitting determinant -1 and direct rational counts #E(F2)=4 and #S(F2)=8; finite extension checks in inspected source run to F16, but the zeta formula rests on the geometric normalization argument.
residual_risks: The geometric assertion is on a nonempty open of smooth conics, not all quartic surfaces or all conics.
Trace recurrence and zeta apply to only specified F2 model; do not infer generic finite-field model.
